title: perf: avoid resetting the level of request child loggers
body:
Request child loggers were created with `{ level: context.logLevel }`, which defaults to `''` unless the route sets a `logLevel`

pino treats `''` as a level change (`'' !== undefined && '' !== this.level`) and calls `setLevel` with the parent's own level: https://github.com/pinojs/pino/blob/6ba157b1a6727399f9dc01a584d2e08d5094ea57/lib/proto.js#L172-L175

That rebuilds every log method on the child and emits a `level-change` event on every request for no effect, as it still inherits the parent and ends up being a no-op semantically

With the default logger enabled, this change cuts ~100 ns per request (−11.7% in-process, about −2% CPU per request end to end). A side effect is that `fastify.log` no longer emits a redundant `level-change` event for every request.

Default benchmark with `logger: { level: 'info' }`:

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┬────────────┬────────────┬────────┐
│                              Benchmark                              │    main    │     PR     │ Change │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┼────────────┼────────────┼────────┤
│ In-process request path, no sockets (median of 5)                   │ 827 ns/req │ 730 ns/req │ −11.7% │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┼────────────┼────────────┼────────┤
│ HTTP, autocannon -c 100 -p 10, server CPU per request (median of 8) │ 6009 ns    │ 5897 ns    │ −1.9%  │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┼────────────┼────────────┼────────┤
│ Same run, requests/sec                                              │ 168,627    │ 171,546    │ +1.7%  │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┼────────────┼────────────┼────────┤
│ HTTP, -c 100 -p 1, server CPU per request                           │ 8270 ns    │ 8201 ns    │ −0.8%  │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┴────────────┴────────────┴────────┘
```
author: gurgunday
